scope: Bounded-route feasibility for AVI MPEG-4 Part 2 video to fragmented QuickTime MOV packet copy with incompatible AVI MP3 audio explicitly excluded.

audio.disposition: explicitly excluded because the candidate MOV profile accepts AAC audio only

nativeValidationOnly.purpose: FFmpeg was used only to establish standards/container feasibility and independently inspect the disposable candidate; it was not used as the browser converter.

decision: Proceed with an unpublished production-browser candidate. Do not expose avi-to-mov until genuine browser conversion, independent packet/full-decode validation, repeatable large-file memory profiling, cancellation, write-failure, cleanup, and exact no-Docker reproduction all pass.
